title: The regionally proximal relation for commutative semigroup actions
summary: The regionally proximal relation and the equicontinuous structure relation are fundamental relations in topological dynamics that capture equicontinuous behaviour in a topological dynamical system and its factors. For minimal actions of abelian groups they are known to be equivalence relations and to coincide. This development formalizes in Lean 4 the results of the paper "The regionally proximal relation for commutative semigroup actions", which generalizes these facts from group actions to semigroup actions.
